replacement.title: Landing Page Video Content
replacement.definition: The landing page should include the independently requested video content.

items.decision_note: The extraction routing warning identifies message 72 as introducing video content that is not represented by the current inventory.

unresolved_candidate.description: A contact form was proposed and discussed, but the client did not clearly accept it or specify its behavior. The evidence is insufficient to establish a standalone contact-form Requirement.
